map.统计功效计算器。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Statistical Power Calculator. An online tool built for developers, runs entirely in the browser; your code never leaves the device.
map.计算统计检验的功效或所需样本量。: Calculate the power of a statistical test or the required sample size.
map.：功效 = 1 − β，即效应真实存在时正确拒绝原假设的概率。: : power = 1 − β, the probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis when the effect truly exists.
map.：效应量 d、样本量 n、显著性水平 α、检验方向（单侧/双侧），知三可求其一。: : effect size d, sample size n, significance level α, and test direction (one-sided/two-sided); knowing any three lets you solve for the fourth.
map.：功效 0.8 表示有 80% 的概率检出真实存在的效应。: : power of 0.8 means an 80% probability of detecting a truly existing effect.
map.：样本量越大、效应量越大、α 越宽松，功效越高。: : larger sample size, larger effect size, and more lenient α all increase power.
map.功效 = 1 − β = P(拒绝 H₀ | H₁ 为真) ≈ Φ(d√(n/2: Power = 1 − β = P(reject H₀ | H₁ true) ≈ Φ(d√(n/2) − z*₁₋α)
map.在 H₁ 为真时，正确拒绝 H₀ 的概率。: The probability of correctly rejecting H₀ when H₁ is true.
map.第二类错误（取伪错误）概率 = 1 − 功效: Type II error (false negative) probability = 1 − power
map.实验上线前算样本量：若只能接受 20% 的漏检风险，反推需要多少样本才能可靠检出: Before launching an experiment, compute the sample size: if you can only accept a 20% miss-detection risk, back-calculate how many samples are needed to reliably detect the expected minimum lift.
map.d=0.5、功效 0.8 时约需 n≈64/组（两独立样本 t 检验近似）。: At d=0.5 and power 0.8, roughly n≈64 per group (two independent samples t-test approximation).
map.真实存在差异时，有 80% 概率拒绝原假设（即 20% 二类错误）。: When a real difference exists, there is an 80% probability of rejecting the null hypothesis (i.e., a 20% Type II error).
map.为什么实验做完了才看功效没意义？: Why is checking power only after the experiment pointless?
map.功效分析是「实验前」的工具，用来决定样本量；实验结束后再算「事后功效」，实际上只: Power analysis is a "before the experiment" tool used to decide sample size; computing "post-hoc power" after the experiment ends merely restates the already-obtained p-value and cannot prove the conclusion is reliable. The correct approach is to fix the minimum detectable effect, significance level, and power at the design stage, then compute the required sample size and experiment duration.
